build_TransfDecoder: build a transformer decoder model for Diplomacy CICERO order prediction with teacher forcing or sampling
run_TransfDecoder_forward: run the TransfDecoder forward pass with encoder embeddings and candidate order indices to predict orders
run_TransfDecoder_sample: run the TransfDecoder sample method to autoregressively sample Diplomacy orders using nucleus sampling
run_TransfDecoder_compute_loss: run the TransfDecoder compute_loss method to compute teacher-forced loss and greedy decode predictions
build_OrderTokenVocab: build an OrderTokenVocab dataclass to map Diplomacy orders to tokenized feature representations
